cover.alt: Agent的Harness与Runtime双层架构图：蜿蜒的铁路从本地小山坡延伸向远方城市高山，铁轨下方是坚固的基石和管道代表runtime层，铁轨上方是Agent列车驾驶舱和信号灯代表harness层，前景小列车上机器人在操作
cover.prompt: Studio Ghibli anime style watercolor painting, soft natural lighting, warm sunset tones. A winding railway track extends from a small green hill on the left (representing local development) toward distant mountains and a glowing city skyline on the right (representing production environment). Below the tracks, sturdy foundations and pipes symbolizing infrastructure and runtime layer. Above the tracks, a small charming locomotive with a robot operator in the cabin, holding a map and tools symbolizing harness layer. Green meadows, white clouds, wildflowers, small wooden fences in foreground. Rich detailed environment, hand-painted texture, no text or labels.

scenes.alt: 本地开发环境与生产环境对比图：左侧温暖工作室内程序员在笔记本电脑前调试，窗外是宁静草地；右侧是繁忙的数据中心建筑剖面，服务器机柜闪烁指示灯，用户请求如光线般涌入
scenes.prompt: Studio Ghibli anime style watercolor painting, soft natural lighting, warm interior tones on left, cool technical tones on right. Right side shows a cross-section of a large modern data center building with rows of server racks blinking with LEDs, network cables and pipes connecting everywhere, multiple user connections visualized as streams of light particles entering. Cloud shapes floating in background, industrial yet magical atmosphere. Hand-painted texture, no text or logos.

scenes.alt: 持久化checkpoint机制图：蜿蜒的数据河流从山间流出，河岸两侧是PostgreSQL服务器机房建筑，河中有checkpoint浮标标注编号，Agent列车在河流上运行，每节车厢都载着数据
scenes.prompt: Studio Ghibli anime style watercolor painting, soft natural lighting, gentle flowing atmosphere. A winding river of data flowing from misty mountains, river banks lined with PostgreSQL server room buildings resembling traditional Japanese warehouses with glowing windows. Bright checkpoint buoys floating in the river marked with numbers. A small data train running on tracks along the river, each carriage loaded with glowing data cubes and scrolls. Small robots inspecting checkpoints along the river. Green hills, willow trees, stepping stones in water. Dreamy pastel colors, hand-painted watercolor texture, no text or labels.

scenes.alt: 工厂流水线拦截机制图：传送带上Agent机器人经过多个检查站和机械臂，每个工位有透明闸门、机械触手和警示灯，代表拦截输入、过滤输出、限制成本
scenes.prompt: Studio Ghibli anime style watercolor painting, soft natural lighting, industrial workshop atmosphere. Each station has glowing screens and dials. Gear decorations on walls, copper pipes, warm wood elements. Small fairy-like workers monitoring the stations.
